sql:
select fish_date_season as season,
  case when fish_date_doy between 213 and 243 then 'Aug'
       when fish_date_doy between 244 and 273 then 'Sep'
       when fish_date_doy between 274 and 304 then 'Oct'
       when fish_date_doy between 305 and 334 then 'Nov' end as month,
  cls,
  round(sum(yt)::float/nullif(sum(anglers),0),2) as yt_per_angler,
  sum(anglers) as n_anglers
from trips
where fish_date_season = 6 and cls in ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
  and fish_date_doy between 213 and 334
group by 1,2,3
order by 2,3
